automation.description: Signs in as admin in PrimeFaces (tablet UX/UI) and checks Audits, the System Dashboard, Document Numbers and the Jobs list.

interaction.name: Audits: the saves made by the suite are audited
interaction.description: Opens Audits and checks the saves made by the suite have been audited, then opens an audit record.

interaction.name: System Dashboard
interaction.description: Opens the System Dashboard and checks it shows a status and a list of jobs.

interaction.name: Document Numbers: create, find and delete
interaction.description: Creates a document number, finds it, raises its number and saves it, then deletes it and checks it has gone.

interaction.name: Jobs: the backup job has completed
interaction.description: Opens Jobs and checks the completed jobs list holds the suite's one backup job, then opens it and visits the Schedule tab.

method.comment: 00-backup.xml (a set-up, so it runs whatever sail.suite.only chooses) cleared the list then backed up; the 11-user-list.xml and 98-destructive.xml members, which clear it again, run after both 05 members
The schedule is read only: the test server runs without the job scheduler

interaction.name: Document Numbers: generated data, from the document numbers query
interaction.description: Opens the document numbers query and saves a document number filled with generated test data twice, then deletes it.
